title: Strict étale isomorphic-stage projection interfaces
statement: For strict compact-support presentations and a coefficient change, define the normalized quotient projection record, its open/proper composite projection, and the compact-support transport projection record with its evaluation and quotient cubes. These records contain only data and normalization equations; they assert no existence.

source.place: Construction 5.15 and Lemma 5.22; normalized compact-support projection and quotient cubes.
